messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy starting for inference-runtime (prod-usw2)
deploybot: Commit `f1a2b3c4d5e6` • Tag `release/v3.5.7` • Change window 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC
deploybot: Strategy: canary -> greenflip -> full. Canary traffic 10% for 5m, then 50% for 8m, then 100% if checks pass.
deploybot: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/inference-runtime-cutover • Rollback playbook linked there
rebecca: ack — I'll coordinate comms and note the release in the weekly digest :+1:
sam: starting QA smoke now. Running the standard smoke matrix against canary.
ci-bot: smoke-suite/primary — started (job: smoke/inference-runtime/canary-2026-03-20)
mike: Heads up — there's a nonblocking DB migration queued at 22:10. Can we delay that until after greenflip completes? ops-oncall please confirm.
ops-oncall: agree hold DB migration. If canary passes we can schedule migration in the next maintenance window, not during the cutover.
rebecca: noted, DB migration paused. tagging release notes with the migration delay.
mike: also, pinning fallback model variant `tuned-v1` on standby in case quantized path causes regressions.
deploybot: canary deployed -> 10% traffic. smoke results will post here.
sam: quick log snippet from canary smoke:
```
2026-03-20T22:02:15Z INFO request latency 84ms
2026-03-20T22:03:01Z INFO reply tokens 124
2026-03-20T22:04:20Z WARN transient 429 from edge-12 (retrying)
```
sam: overall smoke OK, one transient 429, retries passed. marking canary as PASSED :white_check_mark:
deploybot: Canary PASSED. Increasing traffic to 50% (greenflip phase).
ops-oncall: monitoring p95 latency and 5xx. thresholds set: p95 +20% OR errors > 1% => automatic rollback.
mike: confirming fallback route configured: `route: inference-runtime -> tuned-v1` if rollback triggered.
rebecca: tagging release with notes: "perf improvements, KV-cache fixes, safer batching" — will publish once fully complete.
deploybot: Greenflip at 50% — soaking for 8m. Telemetry: p95 +3%, errors 0.2% (within thresholds).
rebecca: good so far, notifying support on-call and #support channel.
ops-oncall: check on memory - canary pods showing steady RSS, no OOMs.
ci-bot: perf-check job finished: p50 +2ms, p95 +10ms, no regressions flagged.
sam: running a couple more eval prompts against 50% traffic to capture edge cases.
deploybot: Traffic shifted to 100% — rolling out final replicas. Starting post-cutover health checks.
mike: verifying infra autoscaler behavior — replicas scaled from 6 -> 10 during ramp, now stable at 8.
ops-oncall: no high-severity alerts. RPS and latency within SLO.
deploybot: DEPLOY COMPLETE • Prod cutover finished
deploybot: Commit `f1a2b3c4d5e6` • Tag `release/v3.5.7`
rebecca: awesome — marking release DONE and adding notes to the changelog. :tada:
sam: QA final smoke green. Will add regression screenshots to the ticket.
mike: thumbs up from infra, monitoring dashboards look good.
ops-oncall: leaving extra 30m of heightened monitoring, will escalate if anything pops up.
rebecca: closing this channel for the deploy. If any rollback is needed, use the rollback playbook and ping @ops-oncall immediately.
deploybot: Post-deploy metrics summary: 5m p95 152ms, errors 0.18%, token cost delta -1.2%
rebecca: published release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/notes/v3.5.7
rebecca: thanks everyone — nice coordinated cutover. :shipit:
